coords: normalised 0-1, origin top-left of the frame
note: explode.frames[j].anchors are the 2D anchor points of each labelled part in explode frame j; labels are meant to be shown on the last (fully exploded) frame. rotate anchors are informational (visible=false means occluded at that angle).

parts.name: Tempered Glass Side Panel
parts.description: A tinted, toughened-glass side that shows off the build inside. It lifts off so you can get at the components.

parts.name: Front Mesh Panel
parts.description: A perforated front that lets the intake fans pull in plenty of cool air while hiding the fans behind it.

parts.name: ARGB Front Fans
parts.description: Three 120 mm intake fans with addressable RGB rings. They push fresh air across the GPU and motherboard.

parts.name: Rear ARGB Fan
parts.description: A 120 mm exhaust fan behind the CPU area that pushes warm air out of the back of the case.

parts.name: Top Dust Filter
parts.description: A removable fine mesh over the roof's fan and radiator mounts that keeps dust out and lifts off for cleaning.

parts.name: Front I/O Panel
parts.description: The power button plus the USB and audio ports on top of the case, wired to headers on the motherboard.

parts.name: PSU Shroud
parts.description: A steel cover over the power supply and spare cables in the bottom of the case, so the build looks tidy through the glass.

parts.name: Expansion Slots
parts.description: Seven slot openings in the rear wall where the graphics card and other add-in cards are screwed in place.
